⇒ Position Objective

Our client, a leading FMCG enterprise operating across ASEAN, is seeking an Agentic AI & Automation Engineer to design, build, and deploy custom AI-powered solutions from scratch. The role sits within the Digital Commercial & AI team and spans two core areas: building autonomous agentic AI workflows, and developing intelligent automation pipelines that connect systems and eliminate manual processes across commercial and operational functions.

Initial engagement is 3 months, with strong likelihood of extension to 6–12 months for the right person.

⇒ Main Responsibilities

  • Design and build agentic AI workflows from scratch — including autonomous, multi-step agents capable of reasoning, decision-making, and acting across internal systems without human intervention.
  • Integrate LLMs with the client’s existing decision intelligence backend using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP, and structured knowledge base augmentation — not starting from zero, but building on a live data foundation.
  • Build and deliver specific AI agent use cases including a Pricing Agent, Route-to-Market Agent, Recruitment Agent, and Calling/Selling Agent that autonomously handles retailer outreach, cross-selling, and order completion.
  • Design and deploy end-to-end AI-powered automation workflows that eliminate manual, repetitive tasks across sales, HR, operations, and commercial functions — using tools such as n8n, Azure Logic Apps, or equivalent.
  • Connect automation pipelines to enterprise systems via REST APIs and webhooks — including CRM, ERP, HR platforms, and BI tools — ensuring reliable, production-grade integrations.
  • Own the full delivery lifecycle: scoping, architecture, build, testing, and handover — with full documentation and clear token/cost governance across all AI components.
  • Work in a fast-moving, agile environment across Malaysia and the broader ASEAN cluster, with the expectation of delivering a working solution within the first 3 months of engagement.

⇒ Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Credentials are secondary to a demonstrated ability to build and ship in production.
  • More than 3 years of hands-on experience building AI or automation solutions. Prior experience in FMCG, retail, B2B commerce, or a similarly fast-moving commercial environment is a strong advantage.
  • Proven ability to build agentic AI systems from scratch — not configuring off-the-shelf SaaS tools. Must be able to design agent logic, manage state, handle errors, and deploy independently.
  • Strong proficiency in Python. Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent), workflow tools (n8n, Power Automate, or equivalent), and prompt engineering in production contexts.
  • Solid understanding of RAG architectures: retrieval design, embedding pipelines, knowledge base structuring, and augmentation strategies for enterprise data environments.
  • Experience with Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio) and a working knowledge of LLM concepts including MCP, function/tool calling, token management, and cost optimisation.
  • Comfortable integrating with enterprise systems via REST APIs and webhooks. Can read documentation independently and build reliable connectors when off-the-shelf solutions fall short.
  • Strong delivery instinct: able to scope a use case, map the workflow, build a maintainable solution, and hand it over — without over-engineering or requiring extensive supervision.
  • Self-directed and output-focused. Comfortable operating in a lean team at pace, and capable of delivering a working solution within a 3–6 month engagement window.

Position Summary:

Join our Data and Analytics team to be at the forefront of bringing AI Agents from concept to production, enabling teams across Infineum to turn ideas into real, measurable impact. Apply cutting‑edge agent frameworks and LLM‑powered automation to solve real business problems at scale, accelerating digitalisation across our global organisation.

In this role, contribute how our data, systems, and applications become “AI‑ready.” Guide business stakeholders from a spark of inspiration to deployed agent solutions that streamline workflows, amplify expertise, and unlock new value. Whether you’re governing the lifecycle of an agent, refining its behaviour, or deploying it into production environment, you’ll be the technical force ensuring our agents are safe, reliable, and truly helpful.

If you’re excited about building and operationalising AI agents, collaborating across functions, and making AI real for hundreds of users, this role offers the perfect platform to grow, innovate, and see your work drive impact.

Key Responsibilities / What You'll Achieve

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure projects deliver meaningful business impact.
  • Manage the full agent lifecycle, ensuring timely delivery, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a technical lead when working with partners to deliver internal agent‑related projects.
  • Support business functions, which use our no-code agent platform (Copilot Studio), by providing expertise and best practices in AI agents and their practical applications.
  • Stay current with state‑of‑the‑art developments in agent frameworks, AI tooling, and LLM technologies to code custom-built AI agents.
  • Deploy agents into production environments, ensuring they are robust, secure, and scalable.
  • Contribute to best practices that make enterprise data AI‑ready - for example, helping craft semantic descriptions of SQL schemas and developing MCP‑based tooling for agent access to legacy applications.
  • Help to identify opportunities for developing and integrating AI agents that convert data into actionable insights.

What will you gain from this role?

  • Hands‑on expertise in agent tech stacks - including frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, GraphRAG with Neo4j, and MCP‑based tooling that brings legacy systems into the world of intelligent automation.
  • Experience the entire lifecycle of agent development, giving you the opportunity to take ideas from concept to production and directly see how your work improves the daily experience of colleagues across our business.
  • Build both technical and non‑technical strengths, from solution design and systems thinking to stakeholder communication, coaching business users, and driving adoption of agentic workflows.
  • A collaborative, forward‑looking team culture with a “can‑do” mindset, where your ideas shape how Infineum harnesses AI agents and where you contribute to a growing community of agent builders transforming the organisation.
  • Continuous learning as the field evolves rapidly, with access to cutting‑edge tech stack, new frameworks, and enterprise AI operations practices.

Skills & Qualifications

Required:

  • Demonstrated hands‑on experience building AI agents end‑to‑end, from concept through to a functioning solution using any agent or LLM framework.
  • Practical experience using agent tooling, including working with MCP servers or similar mechanisms that allow agents to interact with external systems.
  • Ability to technically guide multi‑stakeholder projects, showing that you can coordinate with partners, communicate clearly, and help shape solution direction.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and comfort with version control tools such as Git.
  • Exposure to Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD tooling, demonstrating familiarity with development and deployment workflows.


Preferred:

  • Infineum has a Microsoft-first tech stack:
  • Experience with Azurecloud services, including familiarity with AI‑related offerings such as Azure AI Foundry and/or Azure OpenAI.
  • Exposure to Microsoft no-code agent builder platform called Copilot Studio.
  • Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Agent Framework (or Auto Gen and Semantic Kernel), and/or LangGraph/LangChain, and an understanding of the limitations of each framework.
  • Experience monitoring, evaluating, and improving custom built AI agents once deployed to production - e.g., evaluation, guardrail tuning, observability, or lifecycle governance.
  • Familiarity with deploying and operating agents for business use, not just for testing, including secure connector usage and integration with legacy systems.
  • A postgraduate degree (master’s or higher) in Computer Science, Life Science, Mathematics, or equivalent demonstrated experience in applied AI or data science.

3. Quality & Adversarial Testing

  • Proactively red-team AI systems — adversarial prompting, edge-case and jailbreak testing — to surface failure modes before clients do.
  • Detect and quantify hallucination, bias, and drift in production and pre-production systems, producing clear, defensible metrics (not qualitative impressions).

  • Maintain evaluation and prompt-version documentation and reporting standards that align with client compliance and audit needs (e.g., government AI governance requirements).
